beats.summary: Dwight presents Michael with a Hassenfass knife, describing its features and offering additional survival gear.

evidence.snippet: Dwight: And this… is a Hassenfass. Case-hardened steel. One side, as sharp as you'd ever want something to be. The other side serrated for maximum damage.
Dwight: Don't you want a sheath for that?

beats.summary: Michael insists he only needs the knife and refuses other survival items Dwight suggests.

evidence.snippet: Michael: No, just get me a case. All right.

beats.summary: Dwight looks at the camera and removes the sheath from his ankle to give to Michael.

evidence.snippet: [STAGE] Dwight looks at the camera, lifts his leg onto the desk, removes the sheath from his ankle, and gives it to Michael

notable_quotes.quote: All I will need are my instincts and my will to survive.
notable_quotes.speaker: Michael

evidence.snippet: Michael: I'm telling you, all I will need are my instincts and my will to survive.

uncertainties: What is the exact name of the knife Michael is holding up at the end?

uncertainty_items.question: What is the exact name of the knife Michael is holding up at the end?
uncertainty_items.why_uncertain: Michael asks for the name but it is not provided in the segment.

evidence.snippet: Michael (holding up knife): What is this called again?
